english.title: Operator of UK-registered public transport aircraft fail to make training manual available to trainer
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of public transport aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, failed to make available to every person appointed by the operator to give or to supervise the training, experience, practice or periodical tests required under article 114(2) of the Air Navigation Order 2016 a training manual which complied with article 117(4) of the Order and ensure that each copy of that training manual was kept up to date
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 117 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
